# Parley v0.1.59

This unnotarized test beta adds local voice input, reviewed spoken handoffs
and optional read-aloud. It also includes the remaining September repository
review fixes merged since v0.1.58.

## Voice input and handoffs

- Select a running agent pane and hold **Dictate** or **Control-Shift-Space**.
  Release to edit the transcript, then explicitly choose **Paste** without
  Enter, **Send**, or an editable **Ask/Delegate** draft. Keyboard or VoiceOver
  activation of Dictate toggles recording.
- A draft keeps its reviewed pane, vendor, workspace, folder and launch
  generation. Changing the selected pane never redirects it. Changed or
  unavailable destinations are refused; both participants in a voice handoff
  are checked again before paste and Enter. Existing vendor permission and
  Copilot folder-trust prompts remain in force.
- **Settings > Voice** offers English (United Kingdom) and English (United
  States). On supported macOS 26 Macs, explicitly download Apple's local
  speech model there first. The older or unsupported-hardware path requires
  macOS to report on-device dictation support. There is no cloud recognition
  fallback, and Parley's minimum remains macOS 14.
- Recordings are limited to 60 seconds; transcripts to 8,000 characters.
  Parley saves no raw audio. Drafts remain in memory until delivered,
  discarded or the app quits. Explicit handoffs follow normal history
  retention, and text delivered to a vendor follows that CLI's handling.
- Microphone consent is requested by the packaged app. The older speech
  backend also requires Speech Recognition consent. If granting permission
  interrupts a hold, start another recording afterwards. Missing assets or
  denied access leave a recoverable message.

## Optional read-aloud

- Read-aloud starts off. Enable it in Voice settings, then use **Voice > Read
  Selection** for an actual terminal selection or **Read Result** for a
  returned Ask/Delegate in Status Center.
- The queue holds three items of up to 8,000 characters, with removal and
  stop/clear controls. Status Center keeps the settings link, queue and errors
  beside the result, including when the main workbench window is hidden.
- Recording and playback cannot overlap. Nothing is spoken automatically;
  speech never approves tools, infers agent completion or executes navigation
  commands. Native controls and transcript editing retain keyboard focus.

## Review follow-ups

- Tighten socket and command-worker identity checks, and restore clean signal
  state before an approved worker hands over to its login shell.
- Preserve reviewed launch folders in saved layouts and workspace creation;
  strengthen context-rejection revision checks and command-capture accounting.
- Keep worktree prediction read-only, validate integration branches and
  distinguish bare repositories from primary checkouts. Container discovery
  and cleanup use the same fixed Docker executable allowlist.
- Extend menu accessibility and regression coverage for these paths.

## Validation and known limits

The merged voice implementation passed 418 native checks and all 59 script
tests in GitLab's macOS VM, plus the app build and repository scans. Two
Docker-only checks were explicitly skipped because that VM has no Docker
runtime. The 25-round eight-pane Ghostty soak also passed locally. The release
workflow repeats checks, soak, packaging, checksums and packaged-launch
verification before publishing this beta.

Real microphone input, consent denial/revocation, keyboard/VoiceOver interaction
and audible playback across the supported OS/language configurations remain
manual acceptance work. Those checks have not been claimed as passed; the
voice task remains open for them. Model download cancellation is a request to
macOS: use Check Speech Support to inspect the shared download's state.

This is an ad-hoc-signed, unnotarized test beta. It does not update the stable
Sparkle feed or Homebrew cask. Follow the included installation instructions.
